key_insight: PEPO replaces uniform token credit in RLVR with proximal entropy, a local importance measure that better captures which tokens actually matter for learning.
engineering_relevance: For reasoning-model training, this yields a drop-in way to assign token-level rewards more accurately than global entropy or uniform advantages, improving optimization without changing the base RL framework.
method: Compute proximal entropy from neighboring tokens rather than the full batch.
Use proximal entropy to weight per-token advantages in Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization (PEPO).
Show the same local-entropy idea can substitute into other RL methods and even single-stream RL.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, outperforming GRPO and entropy-based baselines.
watch_item: Because PEPO adds token-level weighting, implementation quality and hyperparameter sensitivity may matter when integrating it into existing RL training pipelines.
paper_title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization
